title: Surjectivity of Finite Rank-Capped Enots-Wolley Sequences
summary: For each fixed integer $K\ge2$, we consider the Enots--Wolley sequence in which every term after the initial $1,2$ is required to have between two and $K$ distinct prime divisors. We prove that every integer satisfying this restriction occurs. If an exact prime support $T$ were selected only finitely often, then after a finite cutoff the terms meeting $T$ would form short episodes, and every full term would force an earlier proper term at comparable numerical height.
